verdict.rationale: Gide's own materials touch founder equity: there is a published insight on BSPCE taxation under the 2026 finance law (a French founder-warrant instrument, arguably the local tax-equivalent angle), a management-packages team that serves company founders, and an employee share schemes practice combining legal, tax and employment expertise. None of this addresses day-zero founder ownership setup directly. Missing for 10: vesting schedules, explicit 83(b)-equivalent election guidance, co-founder equity split guidance, founder-focused formation content, independent corroboration.
